answer: Rule: one identity anchors to one seasoned external-chain account, a willow rooted once in a canyon wall, never twice. The anchor needs 90 days and 50 real transactions on Solana or Base, checked by a bridge oracle, and the identity locks 40 opal units until audit. Reuse an anchor and both deposits burn. One fake costs one seasoned account plus 40 units; ten fakes need ten accounts and 400 units, and each extra account costs more to buy, so the bill climbs faster than the count.
